name: 3P - metaobjects
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose 3P - metaobjects.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.content: Use a published, storefront-accessible metaobject page with name or title (text). Optional fields: logo (image file), short_description and shipping_notes (text/rich text), default_lead_time (text), regions_served (text or text list), website_url (URL), catalog_collection (collection reference). Definition setup and fulfillment are managed outside this section.
